scope: Exploratory common-loss accounting from every final-selected full-development curve; one endpoint-selected joint LR per method, never a per-threshold/per-seed envelope
threshold_grid: 4.0 to9.5 inclusive in0.1increments; all outcomes retained
interpolation: linear between adjacent recorded full-development observations; interval bounds are resolution bounds, not confidence intervals
censoring: Unreached targets and initial-time crossings have no ratio; no extrapolation
